Have you ever wondered why true happiness and fulfillment can sometimes feel just out of reach? In a world that never seems to slow down, finding meaning and direction becomes something we all crave. But what if there were a handful of principles—simple, practical, and time-tested—that could light the way forward?
That’s exactly what we’ll discover together as we explore the heart of Gordon B. Hinckley’s inspiring book, Way to Be!: 9 Ways To Be Happy And Make Something Of Your Life. This isn’t just another list of lofty ideals. Instead, these nine ways are everyday virtues that can help you build resilience, show more kindness, and feel a real sense of accomplishment—no matter what life throws your way.
Each principle blends timeless wisdom with down-to-earth steps you can start using right now. Imagine living with more integrity, compassion, and optimism—creating habits that not only lift you up, but inspire everyone around you too.
As we walk through these nine ways together, you’ll see that happiness doesn’t have to be some far-off dream. It’s something you can practice, day by day. So, are you ready to take this journey? Let’s dive in and discover how small choices can lead to a richer, more meaningful life—for you, and for all those you touch along the way.
